poem:
Water - WebAssembly Text Format Compiler

Water flows through silicon dreams,
Tiny currents and binary streams,
Parsing text to binary form,
WASM compiling, performance norm.

WebAssembly's liquid heart,
Elegant and performant art,
From WAT to WASM it flows,
Where web computation grows.

Small and swift, a compiler's dance,
Giving browsers a fighting chance,
Water—the essence refined,
Compiling code, streamlined.
